name: steph17ot
caption:
17 POINTS IN ONE OVERTIME 🎮🏀 Steph's first game back from a sprained knee, and Portland is up 10 at the half.

• Game 4, 2016 West semis, May 9, 2016, in Portland
• Blazers lead 67-57 at halftime
• Overtime: Steph scores 17, an NBA record
• 40 points, and we win 132-125 to go up 3-1

"I'm back!" Best return game ever? 👇

beats.head: BEST RETURN?
beats.vo: Best return game ever? Comment below.

facts.claim: Game 4, 2016 Western Conference semifinals, May 9, 2016 at Portland: Curry returned from a sprained right knee (first game back) to score an NBA-record 17 points in overtime (one overtime period is five minutes), finishing with 40 as the Warriors won 132-125 to take a 3-1 lead. Portland led 67-57 at the half (down 10). Curry nailed a 3 in OT and exclaimed "I'm back!"
